description: Third-party port of elytra flight mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge. Allow ground takeoff & infinite elytra flight without fireworks.

mods.name: NoFireWorkFly Neo
mods.description: This mod enhances the elytra flight experience by removing the need for fireworks. You can launch into the air and sustain flight entirely without consuming any firework rockets.

releases.notes:
## Bug Fix

- Fixed: Players could trigger elytra takeoff and flight without wearing an elytra.
  The Caelus attribute has a default value of 0.1, causing canElytraFly() to always
  return true. Now checks for actual modifier presence instead of raw attribute value.

## Install

Requires NeoForge ≥ 21.1.233 and Caelus ≥ 7.0.

# NoFireworkFly v0.1
Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
Loader: NeoForge

Features:
- Sprint + jump ground elytra takeoff

- Compatible with do_a_barrel_roll

Installation:
Place the jar into your mods folder.
